sec: Empty sella syndrome and dynamic pituitary reserve evaluation

items.q: Match the empty sella syndrome classification to its underlying etiology — 1) Primary (1°) empty sella 2) Secondary (2°) empty sella … A) Benign intracranial hypertension (BIH) with dural herniation and intact pituitary rim B) Prior pituitary tumor regression, apoplexy, necrosis, surgery or radiation
items.exp: Primary empty sella is caused by BIH and dural herniation; secondary empty sella results from tumor regression, necrosis, or surgery. (Book p956)

items.q: Assess the clinical consequences of empty sella syndromes: I Primary empty sella maintains an intact rim of pituitary parenchyma, resulting in normal endocrine function without hypopituitarism. II Secondary empty sella typically presents with features of hypopituitarism.
opts: Both I and II are true
Both I and II are false
items.exp: Primary empty sella has an intact rim and normal hormone function; secondary empty sella presents with hypopituitarism (+). (Book p956)

items.q: A 34-year-old obese female with chronic headaches and pseudotumor cerebri (BIH) undergoes brain MRI, revealing CSF filling the sella turcica with a flattened pituitary rim. Basal pituitary hormone levels are completely normal. What is the diagnosis?
items.exp: Primary empty sella occurs in BIH due to dural tear and CSF herniation; the compressed rim remains intact so there is no hypopituitarism. (Book p956)

items.q: Which pituitary hormone can be directly evaluated with a baseline serum level without requiring dynamic provocation?
items.exp: Prolactin, FSH/LH, and TSH are directly measured; GH requires dynamic provocation tests (ITT or glucagon). (Book p956)

items.q: What two dynamic stimulation tests are utilized to evaluate growth hormone reserve in hypopituitarism?
opts: Insulin tolerance test and Glucagon stimulation test
Oral glucose suppression test and Water deprivation test
Dexamethasone suppression test and CRH stimulation test
Metyrapone test and Cosyntropin stimulation test
items.exp: GH provocation tests include the Insulin Tolerance Test and the Glucagon Stimulation Test. (Book p956)

items.q: In the metyrapone dynamic test, metyrapone selectively inhibits the enzyme 11-beta-hydroxylase, blocking the conversion of 11-deoxycortisol to ___.
items.exp: Metyrapone blocks the conversion of 11-deoxycortisol to cortisol. (Book p956)

items.q: Match the subject response on the metyrapone test to its biochemical outcome — 1) Normal individual with intact ACTH axis 2) Patient with pituitary ACTH deficiency … A) Absence of cortisol stimulates ACTH release, causing marked accumulation of 11-deoxycortisol B) Inability to produce ACTH prevents precursor stimulation, resulting in low 11-deoxycortisol
items.exp: Normal: lack of cortisol rises ACTH and 11-deoxycortisol; ACTH deficiency: 11-deoxycortisol remains decreased. (Book p956)

items.q: Which test is NOT utilized to assess hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (ACTH) reserve in hypopituitarism?
items.exp: ACTH reserve is evaluated by ITT, cosyntropin stimulation, and metyrapone testing; water deprivation assesses ADH. (Book p956)

items.q: What synthetic ACTH analogue is administered in the standard stimulation test to evaluate adrenal responsiveness?
items.exp: Cosyntropin is synthetic ACTH 1-24 used in the stimulation test. (Book p956)

items.q: In primary empty sella syndrome, elevated intracranial CSF pressure creates a tear in the ___ mater layer.
items.exp: Elevated pressure causes a tear in the dura mater of the diaphragma sellae. (Book p956)

items.q: Assess pituitary function in primary empty sella: I The pituitary rim is preserved against the sellar floor. II Endocrine hormone testing is classically normal.
opts: Both I and II are true
Both I and II are false
items.exp: In primary empty sella, the rim is intact and hormone levels are normal without hypopituitarism. (Book p956)

items.q: A clinician performs a metyrapone test on a patient with suspected secondary adrenal failure. Post-metyrapone serum cortisol is suppressed, and 11-deoxycortisol is markedly reduced. This confirms:
items.exp: ACTH deficiency prevents precursor accumulation, confirming secondary adrenal insufficiency with low 11-deoxycortisol. (Book p956)
